response.answer: Carmen Mayora-Cebollero is a leading researcher in deep learning for analyzing chaotic dynamics in frog heart signals. She collaborates with institutions like Universidad de Zaragoza and Georgia Tech. Her work focuses on applying deep learning techniques to biological time series.

results.title: [PDF] Deep Learning for analyzing chaotic dynamics in biological time series
results.content: In this study, we focus on a first attempt to automate the analysis of chaotic dynamics in cardiac time series (in our case, frog heart signals) using Deep Learning techniques and a periodically paced cardiac action potential map [1,2] to verify validity, as iterative maps remain a valuable tool for studying chaos in cardiac cell models [3–5]. Analysis of chaotic dynamics is performed, using the network chosen in Step 3, on the experimental data (in our case, APD time series from frog heart signals). In the bifur-cation diagram of Fig. 12(A), the DL analysis of chaotic dynamics of the experimental heart data is represented following the same code of col-ors of the study of Dataset 1 (blue for regular samples correctly detected comparing with expert criteria, red for correctly classified chaotic time series, and black for “incorrectly” classified signals).

Analysis of chaotic dynamics is performed with the network chosen in Step 3 in the experimental data (in our case, APD time series from frog heart signals). This does not occur with this Beeler-Reuter APD heart map, so we normalize the data to the interval [0,1][0,1] before performing the DL analysis of chaotic dynamics (a random number sampled uniformly in such interval is assigned to constant time series and a linearly mapping between the range of non-constant samples to the interval [0,1][0,1] is done otherwise).
